visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit indoor home setting where a young boy with glasses and a dark t-shirt sits at a wooden table. A woman in a black strap top stands behind him while he addresses the camera. A yellow graphic with a lemon tart and floating text like '點心時間' and '酸酸檸檬塔' appears in the foreground. (2) The boy takes a large bite of a lemon tart, and the camera cuts to a medium close-up of his face as he winces in a dramatic, scrunched-up sour reaction. The woman smiles and watches him closely. Large variety captions like '好酸喔' shake across the screen to emphasize the physical emotion of the moment. (3) The scene shifts outdoors to a modern grey building with the 'creammm.t' logo prominently displayed on the wall. The woman, now wearing a white blouse and green skirt, gestures enthusiastically toward the storefront. The lighting is bright natural daylight, casting clear shadows on the stone-paved walkway and nearby palm trees. (4) Inside the bakery, the woman points at various pastries within a glass display case. The setting is a minimalist, clean retail environment with soft indoor lighting. Close-up shots highlight the golden-brown textures of the scones and the intricate rose-shaped frosting of the lemon tarts being presented. (5) The woman is shown eating a scone topped with red jam and cream. She closes her eyes in delight and nods her head. The camera uses a split-screen technique to show the interior texture of the broken scone. Variety text '原來司康這麼好吃' appears in white at the bottom. (6) The action returns to the indoor table where the boy eats a different lemon tart and gives an immediate thumbs up. The woman laughs while standing beside him. A text box '高度好評' and a red explosion graphic appear above the boy's head to signal his strong approval.

The speech density increases as the woman enthusiastically lists the sensory qualities of the scones and jam. The pop BGM continues with a bright, driving rhythm. (6) The sequence concludes with the boy's voice returning, sounding satisfied and calm. A final burst of laughter SFX and a playful cartoon sound effect accompany the dialogue. The BGM fades out smoothly during the final few seconds, leaving only a brief moment of studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional feature for the 'creammm.t' bakery. It uses a comedic framing device featuring a mother and son to contrast 'too sour' or 'too sweet' homemade/unknown tarts with the 'perfect' balance of the brand's products. The narrative guides the viewer from a relatable family interaction to a visit to the physical flagship store in Taichung, highlighting product variety and gift box aesthetics.
